2024 Financials

The Audit Committee held six meetings during 2024. The Audit

Committee retained the independent public accounting firm of

Crowe LLP to perform the audit of BECU's 2024 financial statements.

The Audit Committee has reviewed and discussed BECU's 2024

audited financial statements with Crowe, the credit union's Chief

Audit Executive and management. In carrying out its responsibilities,

the Audit Committee believes that appropriate internal controls are

in place at BECU and that the 2024 financial statements accurately

reflect the strong financial position of the credit union.

Bill Longbrake, Chairperson, BECU Audit Committee
